notes.title: Updates incoming.
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We've been busy this week fixing a few minor bugs and also adjusting the difficulty in some levels. 


Fixed:

Sound adjustments
Enemy fish stuck on objects when defeated
Fish in bubbles popping when touching another bubble


Now, let's get back to catching boomer fish for Riley.

notes.title: Updates
notes.content:
Hello RnR fans,

We're aware of the fish not showing up in the haunted ship. We believe the ship is haunted with fish ghosts and sometimes they disappear into thin air. Really.

[h1]Fixed:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Wave SFX in Title Screen and Main Menu
[*]Fish disappearing in the haunted ship 
[/list]

Also, we've been creating gameplay videos on our YouTube page. [b]Spoiler alert[/b] ːsteammockingː 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wpWf21Uuq2U]RnR Youtube[/url]  

Happy gaming everyone!

notes.title: Play-testing is now over.
notes.content:
We want to give a big thank you to all the folks that play-tested the game as we get ready for our Friday release. 

Please enjoy your free copy of the game, and happy gaming!

notes.title: Looking for play-testers
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

We at MadFrog Studios are looking for 10 people interested in play testing our game Rupert and Riley. You will receive a free download of the game. All we ask in return is your feedback concerning any issues you experience while playing through the game. 

For those interested please send us an email at madfrogstudio@gmail.com with the subject line Playtest. Please include your name, operating system and version you'll be playing on; Windows, MAC or Linux and your hardware specs.


Thanks and we look forward to hearing from you!

notes.title: Getting ready!
notes.content:
Hello gamers,

The RnR team is ready and excited to release our first game. We hope you enjoy the game as much as we did creating it!

We'll be handing out beta keys in the next two weeks, so be sure to check out our facebook page to grab one. We'll also post updates here on when and where to get them.

Our hope is that Rupert and Riley gets tons of love so that they can continue their adventures in the future. 

Wish them luck!  ːsteamhappyː
